post.text:
RFK Jr: "A Democratic senator claimed it's mathematically impossible to have a drug drop by 600%. I said, 'Well, if the drug was $100 and it raises to $600, that would be a 600% rise. If it drops from $600 to $100, that's a 600% savings.'"

Trump: "Right" https://t.co/yhDatDqp33

description.description: A video capture from the Oval Office showing Donald Trump seated at the Resolute Desk, surrounded by various individuals in suits. A man in a dark suit standing behind the desk is gesturing with his hands while speaking. The setting includes multiple flags and office decor.

tweetMedia.transcription: I was reminded when the president was speaking of a conversation that I had yesterday with one of the Democratic senators who was questioning me during a hearing and she was ridiculing President Trump for his math. She was saying it's mathematically impossible to have a drug drop by 600% cost, which he had claimed. And I said, well, if the drug was $100 and it raised the price to $600, that would be a 600% rise. If it drops from 600 to 100, that's a 600% savings. And the president used that mathematical device to illustrate the magnitude of the theft that has been happening against our country and our people, as he said.
